eppo-gd.title: EPPO Global Database: the scientific name of a plant or a pest, its common names in each language, and the hosts of a pest

eu-variety-catalogue.title: European Commission: plant variety catalogues, databases and information systems (the common catalogue of varieties of vegetable species)
eu-variety-catalogue.note: The catalogue lists a variety by name and maintainer. What a variety differs in is drafted from its breeder's or its seed house's description, which the reviewer finds from there.

geonames.title: GeoNames geographical database: a place's name and its coordinates
geonames.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0: free to use, with attribution to GeoNames.
geonames.note: The gazetteer the places are to be checked against. Their coordinates were drafted to two decimal places and not copied from it.

harrington-germination.title: J. F. Harrington, Department of Vegetable Crops, University of California, Davis: Soil temperature conditions for vegetable seed germination, as Oregon State University Extension publishes it
harrington-germination.note: The table is of vegetable seed. A herb's, a flower's or a green manure's germination temperature and days cite it for want of that crop's own source, which the reviewer finds: the value is not in the table.

lwg-2104-mischkultur.title: Bayerische Landesanstalt für Weinbau und Gartenbau, Bayerische Gartenakademie: Merkblatt 2104, Mischkulturen im Gemüsegarten
lwg-2104-mischkultur.note: The leaflet says of the literature on neighbours that its reports of experience often contradict one another. A claim it supports no further than that is traditional here.

lwg-2111-fruchtfolge.title: Bayerische Landesanstalt für Weinbau und Gartenbau, Bayerische Gartenakademie: Merkblatt 2111, Fruchtfolge für Gemüsebeete
lwg-2111-fruchtfolge.note: The leaflet is of the vegetable bed. A herb's, a fruit's, a flower's or a green manure's rotation break cites it for want of that crop's own source, which the reviewer finds: the value is not in the leaflet.

nasa-power.title: NASA Langley Research Center, Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) project: daily minimum temperature at 2 metres (T2M_MIN, from MERRA-2, on a grid of 0.5° by 0.625°), 1991 to 2020, and the elevation of its grid cell
nasa-power.licence: NASA's Earth science data are free and open to any use. The POWER project asks to be cited: these data were obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project funded through the NASA Earth Science/Applied Science Program.
nasa-power.note: The values are computed from the source, not copied: reference-data/tools/garden-climate.mjs is the method. A hardiness zone is the USDA's, from the mean of each year's lowest daily minimum.

nchfp.title: National Center for Home Food Preservation, University of Georgia: freezing, drying, canning, fermenting and storing

powo.title: Plants of the World Online, Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew: accepted names and families

rhs-crop-rotation.title: Royal Horticultural Society: Crop rotation
rhs-crop-rotation.note: The page is of the vegetable plot. A herb's, a fruit's, a flower's or a green manure's feeder class cites it for want of that crop's own source, which the reviewer finds: the value is not on the page.

rhs-grow-your-own.title: Royal Horticultural Society: Grow your own fruit, vegetables and herbs, a growing guide per crop
rhs-grow-your-own.note: The guides give sowing and planting times by month for the United Kingdom. A window here is those months restated as days from the frost dates, which is the drafting a reviewer checks. They are of fruit, vegetables and herbs: a flower's or a green manure's field cites them for want of that plant's own guide, which the reviewer finds.

rhs-hardiness.title: Royal Horticultural Society: RHS hardiness rating
rhs-hardiness.note: tender is H1 to H2, half_hardy H3, hardy H4 and above.

rutgers-soil-ph.title: Rutgers New Jersey Agricultural Experiment Station: Commercial Vegetable Production Recommendations, soil and nutrient management (target soil pH by crop)
rutgers-soil-ph.note: The recommendations are for vegetables. A herb's, a fruit's, a flower's or a green manure's soil pH cites them for want of that crop's own source, which the reviewer finds: the value is not in them.

usda-handbook-66.title: USDA Agricultural Research Service: Agriculture Handbook 66, The Commercial Storage of Fruits, Vegetables, and Florist and Nursery Stocks (2016)
usda-handbook-66.note: The handbook gives how long the fresh harvest keeps in store. A shelf life frozen, dried, canned or fermented in a field that cites it is not from it: the reviewer checks those against nchfp.

vt-planting-guide.title: Virginia Cooperative Extension, publication 426-331: Virginia's Home Garden Vegetable Planting Guide, recommended planting dates and amounts to plant
vt-planting-guide.note: The guide is of the vegetables of a home garden. A herb's, a fruit's, a flower's or a green manure's spacing, plants per square metre and yield cite it for want of that crop's own source, which the reviewer finds: the value is not in the guide.

wikidata.title: Wikidata: a taxon's label in each language
wikidata.licence: Creative Commons CC0: no rights reserved.
